kind.description: concept teaches, misconception names the wrong turn most people take.

mascot_line.description: The one sentence worth remembering. A claim, never a question. The sentence you would write on a flashcard.

body.description: The elaboration underneath. Two or three sentences that earn the claim above, with a concrete example wherever one exists. Keep it tight — this card does not scroll.

expression.description: The teacher's pose. Options: explaining = open-handed, mid-explanation, warm. The everyday pose.; considering = hand to chin, weighing something up. Use where the point is that this is the tricky part.; highlighting = one finger raised. Use for the single sentence in this module most worth remembering.; cautioning = palm raised toward the student. Use before a step that needs care, or where people commonly slip.; encouraging = a thumbs up. Use when something has just landed, or the student is past the hard part.

ask_line.description: The teacher's closing line on the ask screen, spoken AFTER the last beat. One or two short sentences: land what was just taught, then ask the student where they want to go next. It must end in a question.
